decisions.reason: Premium customer support is very close to the firm's core hosting and service capabilities, so with its own R&D and hiring the firm is well placed to refine rather than withdraw it.

A software version management tool builds directly on the firm's existing platform, CMS, and management-tool knowledge, and its continued standalone presentation suggests it fits the firm's learning and product direction.

The data processing contract tool is comparatively distant from the firm's main technical hosting and support knowledge base, so despite having R&D the firm is less able to learn from and improve it than its core offerings.
Scalable hosting for agencies is a flagship, multi-model offer at the center of the firm's established capabilities and stated strategy, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.
